summary: Completed testing of Admin Employee module - View button full page navigation and Documents tab with PDF letter generation. All 19 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing employee data (employee_id: 56 - Reeman Saiyed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Employee module fully tested. View button navigates to /admin/employee/:id full page. All 5 tabs (Personal, Work, Bank, Salary, Documents) working. Documents tab allows generating 7 types of HR letters as PDF with company letterhead. Generated documents can be downloaded and deleted.

employees_list_page.details: Admin Employees list page loads correctly with Active (42) and Ex-Employees (51) tabs. View button visible for each employee.

view_button_navigation.details: Click View button navigates to /admin/employee/:id full page (not modal). Tested with employee_id 56.

employee_detail_page_tabs.details: Employee detail page shows all 5 tabs: Personal, Work, Bank, Salary, Documents

personal_tab.details: Shows Email (hr@zestbrains.com), Phone (9033287088), Password (Reeman@zb@56), Birth Date (1 Oct 1999)

work_tab.details: Shows Department(s) (HR), Experience (4 Years), Joining Date (15 Aug 2024), Probation End Date (13 Nov 2024), Team Leaders (None assigned), Leave Summary (Annual PL: 16, PL Taken: 13, CL Taken: 10.5)

bank_tab.details: Shows Bank Name (Hexeros Yes Bank), Account Number (30370100012130), IFSC Code (BARB0DBSGHI)

salary_tab.details: Shows Monthly Salary CTC (Rs. 37,000), Deductions (PT: Rs. 200, ESIC: Rs. 0, EPF: Rs. 0, CPF: Rs. 0), Estimated Net Salary (Rs. 36,800)

documents_tab.details: Shows 7 letter type cards for generation (Offer, Appointment, Experience, Relieving, Internship Appointment, Internship Completion, Increment). Generated Documents list shows previously generated documents with PDF download and delete buttons.

letter_generation_dialog.details: Click letter type opens form dialog with auto-filled fields (letter_date auto-fills to today, department auto-fills from employee data, salary auto-fills from employee data, joining_date auto-fills from employee data)

generate_offer_letter_pdf.details: Fill required fields and click Generate & Download PDF button. PDF is generated and downloaded. Success toast shown. Document appears in Generated Documents list.

download_generated_pdf.details: Click PDF button on generated document downloads the PDF file.

delete_generated_document.details: Click delete button with confirmation deletes document. Document count decreases. Success toast shown.

back_to_employees_button.details: Back to Employees button navigates back using browser history (navigate(-1))

backend_api_documents_generate.details: POST /api/documents/generate generates PDF correctly for all 7 letter types. Returns id, letter_title, pdf_base64, created_at.

backend_api_documents_list.details: GET /api/documents/{employee_id} returns document list without pdf_data field.

backend_api_documents_download.details: GET /api/documents/download/{doc_id} returns PDF file with correct content-type and content-disposition headers.

backend_api_documents_delete.details: DELETE /api/documents/{doc_id} deletes document. Returns 404 for non-existent documents.
